newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba plans to grow telecoms further in 97.
newsitem.headline: Veba plans to grow telecoms further in 97.

text.p: German diversified utility group Veba AG said on Wednesday that it would continue to expand its telecommunications operations with its partner, utility RWE AG.
The joint venture, which was founded in October with RWE, plans in 1997 to offer telephone service to private subscribers.

"We have set the ambitious goal of becoming the premier private carrier in the German telecommunications market," Ulrich Hartmann, Veba's management board chairman, said in the text of a speech to be delivered at a news conference.
Veba said that last year its E-plus mobile telecommunications service brought its customer base up to 500,000 subscribers, more than doubling the previous year's figure.
